{{Top|leg}}
The '''communication wave descrambler''' was a device developed by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Used by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] to unscramble communications of the enemy, its existence was kept a closely-guarded secret.

Some, including [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ratobo]], feared that the military advisers of the [[Confederation]] had stolen the technology during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].
